description: The University of Edinburgh publishes simultaneous velocity measurements from a single-beam acoustic Doppler profiler and an acoustic Doppler velocimeter in the FloWave test facility. Experiments span flow velocities from 0.6 to 1.2 metres per second. Profiler observations cover a ten-metre horizontal line divided into 54 cells, while three-component velocimeter measurements are taken at selected coincident positions. NetCDF archives include instrument quality information and user-derived flags and are free under CC BY 4.0. The laboratory benchmark can validate hydrodynamic simulations and support ocean-energy testing or sensor-comparison studies. Tank geometry and imposed flow conditions are a limitation for transfer to natural waters. Data payloads were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Experimental flow data from co-located Single beam Acoustic Doppler Profiler and Acoustic Doppler Velocimeter in the FloWave Ocean Energy Research Facility
notes: G4-0438; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
